Subject: Feedback on Workplace Conduct

Dear [Employee Name],

I am writing to address some concerns that have been brought to our attention regarding your recent workplace behavior. We value a positive and professional work environment, and it is important that all team members adhere to our company’s core values.

We have received feedback indicating that your conduct has not aligned with these standards. We are committed to supporting you in making the necessary adjustments to ensure a respectful and collaborative atmosphere for everyone.

Please take this as an opportunity to reflect on your interactions and make immediate improvements. We expect to see a prompt and sustained adherence to our professional guidelines moving forward.

If you have any questions or would like to discuss this further, please feel free to reach out to me or HR.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
[Your Title]
